floor_layers._pick: #225 first floor layer (was pristine biome-default invrisil marble, zero floor_layers): the back-alley reads as grimy worn cobble underfoot, distinct from the boulevard's marble plaza. Reuses the Free Pack Floors_Tiles cobble band already VERIFIED as the Liscor street/gate cobble ([16,2]/[17,2]/[18,2], rgb~116,106,94). Footstep-stone stays honest.

entities._comment: Round-trip pair with parlor_to_alleys (brothers_parlor cell 0,4). Cold slate tint, against warehouse_approach's burgundy on the north wall.
entities.display_name: A Plain Door, Better Locks Than It Looks

entities._comment: Her effects are gold/accomplishment only -- no quest id, no start_combat entity.
entities.observe: A tea-tray harness worn shiny at the left shoulder — she pours right-handed and listens left-eared. The cups are chipped. The ears are not.
entities.friendly_line: She pours you a cup without being asked. "On the house," she says, "which is the only kind of trade I ever regret."

dialogue.speaker: Cups
dialogue.text: Tea's on the house. Word costs a gold, and I pour that by the cup too.

entities.observe: Two figures where the alley bends, one standing, one crouched at the wall, and neither has moved since the alley mouth showed them to you.

entities._comment: `alley_footpads_b`, the pair's second placement (east corridor, toward the parlor door).
entities.observe: The second pair, closer to the counting-house door — same trick, same stillness, better light to see it by.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The clean ledger is the tell. Sizing up what is really here takes a practiced read.

on_skill_use.toast: The desk's own ledger reads clean — too clean, the kind of clean a man pays for. Find out how the place is watched before you go digging for the real one.

variants.toast: [Appraise Foe] — Now you know the gap in the watch, the true ledger comes easy: tucked behind a false-backed drawer no honest desk needs. Forty gold to a 'removal man,' dated the night before Coyle's own theft: his hand, his numbers, his mistake.

entities.locked_toast: The ledger on the desk reads clean front to back. Finding the one it was written to cover takes an eye you don't have yet.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Two men keep the counting-house door. Sizing up their rhythm takes a practiced read.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — Two men on the counting-house door, and they're sloppier than they think: the same slow circuit, the same gap while both backs are turned, near enough on the bell to set a watch by. Time it right and the desk inside is yours for a minute, maybe two.

entities.locked_toast: Two men on the door, pacing something. You don't have the eye to time it yet.

entities._comment: Plain on_interact_accomplishment, no skill gate (a fighter-built PC must never need [Appraise Foe] to reach a fight). At [18,10] on the already-blocked north wall; approach [18,11]. NEVER row 11: the map's ONLY through-corridor, so a blocker there strands the east end, and invrisil_disagreement_stealth stands on [16,11] to lift the ledger.
entities.observe: The runner's trail ends at a side door with fresh boot-scuff on the sill and burgundy-and-brass livery moving past the gap in the shutters. Coyle's crew, and no mistaking the building now.
entities.toast: The runner ducks inside, and the gap in the shutters gives you the rest of it: crates stacked to the rafters, more of Coyle's livery than a legitimate warehouse ever needs. The door swings shut on the last of it.

entities._comment: Matches combatants.json's wilovan record + sim_combat_batch.gd's `hired_blades_w10_wilovan`/`hired_blades_w10_solo` cells.
entities.observe: Three men shoulder to shoulder across the passage, burgundy and brass at collar and cuff — Coyle's livery. Clubs and knives in their hands, and no Watch steel among them.

entities._comment: Trap placement 1/2: alley_footpads_a leftover, remnant danger post-safe-passage.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The line is coiled where you dropped it. The crate it was tied to is open and bare.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A line at ankle height, drawn tight from crate to drainpipe; careful hands would start at the knot on the crate end.
entities.locked_toast: A taut line crosses the alley at ankle height, tied off crate to drainpipe. You can't see how to clear it safely.

on_skill_use.toast: You unhook the line and coil it loose. Two coins sit in the crate it was tied to, still folded in a scrap of cloth.

entities._comment: Avoidable: (11,12)/(13,12) both clear. Row 12 blocks x0-1 and x7; x2-6 is the #398 counting-room floor, sealed from the corridor by the x7 wall.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The crates sit flat where you left them, the space behind the bottom one bare paving.
entities.skill_hint_toast: One low oak wedge takes the whole lean, shaved flat where it faces out. Pulling at the crates will not do it; working that wedge out might.
entities.locked_toast: The crate stack looks ordinary until you notice the angle: top-heavy, wedged to fall. The wedge is set low, where you would have to reach in under the weight.

on_skill_use.toast: You brace the stack and ease the wedge free by hand. Behind the bottom crate: a couple of coins someone forgot to collect.

entities._comment: The invrisil SATELLITE alchemy bench -- entry [Low-Grade Synthesis] only, giving [Mixer] a second region. At (1,6), off every QA path; approach from (1,7)/(0,6). Placeholder cauldron sprite (VISUAL-LOG). Banks synthesized_draught.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A cramped apothecary corner, the burner free and the bench rented by the hour. You would need the working to use either.
entities.locked_toast: A back-alley apothecary's bench, crowded with someone else's half-finished work. None of it means anything to you.
entities.observe: Jars in rows with labels turned out, a burner on the bench with a scorch ring under it. The card over the shelf is hand-lettered: WORKING SPACE, BY THE HOUR, NO CREDIT.

on_skill_use.toast: [Low-Grade Synthesis] — Someone else's burner, your working. The draught comes out crude but honest, same as anywhere.

entities._comment: Hedault, Invrisil enchanter. CANON-NATIVE Vol 6-7. Sprite: human placeholder + tint, VISUAL-LOG. No shop -- his commerce is the enchant dialogue.
talk_pool: Appraisal is free to watch and expensive to interrupt.
Do not touch the workbench. Do not touch the wares. Ideally, do not touch anything, including me.
Half this city's 'enchantments' are paint. The other half are apologies. I sell neither.
entities.observe: A severe man at a spotless corner bench, tools laid out at right angles. He looks at your gear before he looks at your face.

entities._comment: INTERACT-ONLY (no trigger_radius) at (11,12): outside both shipped footpad trigger zones and off every pinned cell, so it is correct on a brothers_job_done save. combat_banking's one-shot victory_toast is contract-legal here: the first on_victory id is `original_recovered`, a quest-style String. No item id minted.
entities.display_name: A Back Door with a Ledger Behind It
entities.observe: A door with no handle on this side and a fresh scrape where somebody's boot goes when their hands are full. The ledger inside is worth more than the stock.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The back door has no handle on this side; you have nothing to bring through it.
entities.victory_toast: The Fence's strongbox gives up a lady's stone — forty years missing and still warm with someone else's guilt. It goes in your pack like it weighs more than it does.

entities._comment: #318 beat 2; present_when keeps him off every shipped fixture's alley.
entities.display_name: A Man with a Rented Table
entities.observe: A folding table rented by the day, a cloth over it, and a brass block sitting on the cloth with two letters cut into the face. He has not covered it, because covering a thing is how a street learns you have one.
talk_pool: Brass, boxwood, or wax. Boxwood is cheaper and it cracks, and the crack is always in the one letter you needed.
A name is only worth what the man reading it thinks it is worth. I do not set that price. I only cut the letters.
I rent the table by the day so that on a bad day there is nothing here to take.

entities._comment: #318 beat 2 FIGHT arm, committed from the hub only. present_when is FORBIDDEN on encounters, so the rig parks hidden on wall cell (5,4), which has no walkable neighbour. start_combat resolves by id and reads neither adjacency nor encounter_when, so `call_them` is the single door. Roster and arena are BOTH shipped: footpad_lookout + footpad_bruiser in mercantile_alley is the alley_footpads_t3_warrior10_solo cell, so no new balance cell is owed.
entities.observe: Two men paid by the week whether they work or not, and plainly out of practice.
entities.victory_toast: You take the brass off the cloth yourself. Two letters, cut deep, and a table with nobody left standing beside it.

entities._comment: #398 P4 social gate. Its monotone counter retires the blocker when dialogue ends; (4,8) was static wall before this pocket.
entities.observe: The front passage narrows to one man's width, and the man is in it: fitted gray coat, hands behind him. The key on his cuff-chain hangs outside the sleeve.

entities._comment: #398 P4 quiet gate. Its counter opens the side cell without touching the existing alley route.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The watch turns by a pattern. [Appraise Foe] could mark the open breath; the factor or rear bar offers another way.
entities.locked_toast: The shutter never stays open long. [Appraise Foe] can find the turn; the factor or the rear bar offers another way.
entities.observe: A narrow goods shutter opens onto the side passage. One watcher crosses its view on a fixed turn.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — The watcher turns on the third bell-stroke. You catch the shutter in the breath between one circuit and the next.

entities._comment: #398 P4 force gate. noisy_entry is shared with the factor graph's one reactive line.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The bar is ironwood in stone brackets. [Greater Strength] could shift it; the factor or watch gap offers another way.
entities.locked_toast: The rear bar holds. [Greater Strength] can shift it; the factor or the watch gap offers a quieter way.
entities.observe: An ironwood bar sits deep in stone brackets. Moving it quietly was never part of the design.

on_skill_use.toast: [Greater Strength] — The bar comes out with half the bracket. The counting room hears exactly how you entered.

entities._comment: #398 P4 pocket encounter. Interact-only cannot work behind three disappearing gates, so radius 1 arms once a mode opens and the player crosses in.
entities.observe: A cudgel leaves the desk at the same moment a knife comes out from behind it. The room was closed for a reason.
entities.victory_toast: The counting room falls quiet. A sealed bale remains under the desk.

entities._comment: #398 P4 reward and fence-thread observe hook. Spawns only once the guard clears, so before victory the cell is empty AND sealed behind (7,12).
entities.observe: Two tallies pinned to the bale, the same goods priced twice. The second carries no buyer's name — a hat and a feather inked in the corner. Under it a delivery line: the plain door at the alley's end.
entities.open_toast: The seal parts on a bale of dyed silk, brass findings and sealed spice packets, every tie under the same counting-house stamp.
